nodes.label: laptop memory - the v1 curve-cut experiment, three readings

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the laptop's live memory file - evidence of what this machine believed at that date, listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 7. The user's curve-decides-K idea in three readings through 2026-07-22. First reading, _curve_k under HERB_CURVE_K=1: a head-to-tail straight fit over the ranked chunk-value curve cut at the largest break below it, measured on the det leg at gold-100 k=50 as recall_id 0.6368 / precision_id 0.0650 with kept mean 37.1 against the flat k=50 baseline's 0.6972 / 0.0518 - and the decisive control, a flat k=37 truncation of the same ordering, read 0.6397, so the per-question K is equivalent to a constant and does not find an evidence boundary. The diagnosis, review-verified numerically: the ranked value curve mixes scale regimes and the chord break locks onto that seam, so K measures pool composition, not evidence. Second reading, the height/curve walk: gold-100 det recall 0.7005 / precision 0.0545, but kept hit the 50-ceiling on ALL 100. Third reading, HERB_CURVE_WALK=1 with one progressive frontier cheapest-first, stop on _gap_break and K = min(semantic pool, k): the mechanism works, K spreading 5-50 with median 14, but 10smoke det recall_id reads 0.5058 against flat@50's 0.7751 and against the pre-registered bar - a CONSTANT flat cut at the same mean depth of 23 - which gives 0.6497. Diagnosis: semantic-area tightness is uncorrelated with evidence need on HERB gold questions, where need is driven by citation count and scope territory. Also standing: stored HAS_TAG w_facets are non-signal, and the geometric det facet channel moved recall by at most +0.003
